sentences.en: TUTOR: So now want you to discuss the lesson we've just been watching on the video and think about the ways in which origami can be a useful educational tool
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 那么现在，我希望你们讨论一下我们刚刚在视频中观看的这堂课，并思考折纸作为一种教育工具的多种用途。

sentences.en: Can you all work with the person sitting next to you
sentences.zh: 你们能和坐在旁边的人一起合作吗？

sentences.en: SEB: had no idea that such a simple thing like folding squares of paper to make the shape of something like a bird could be such a an amazing tool
sentences.zh: SEB: 我完全没想到，像把正方形纸折叠成一只鸟这样简单的事情，竟能成为如此了不起的教学工具。

sentences.en: It's made me see origami a in a whole new light
sentences.zh: 它让我对折纸有了全新的认识。

sentences.en: LIA: It know
sentences.zh: LIA: 我知道。

sentences.en: It was interesting to see the educational skills the children were developing by doing origami
sentences.zh: 看到孩子们通过折纸发展出各种教育技能，很有意思。

sentences.en: On the video you could see them really listening /22 hard to make sure they did all the steps in the right order to make the bird
sentences.zh: 在视频中，你可以看到他们全神贯注地听讲，以确保按正确顺序完成每一步，从而折出那只鸟。

sentences.en: SEB: That's right
sentences.zh: SEB: 没错。

sentences.en: In this lesson they were working individually but it would also be interesting to see if the children could work out how to make something simple without being given any direction
sentences.zh: 本节课中，孩子们是独立操作的；但若让他们在没有任何指导的情况下，尝试折出一个简单的东西，那也会很有趣。

sentences.en: That would help with building teamwork as well
sentences.zh: 这同样有助于培养团队协作能力。

sentences.en: LIA: Yes, but much more of a challenge
sentences.zh: LIA: 是的，但难度会大得多。

sentences.en: One thing that really stood out for me was that the children were all having fun while being taught something new
sentences.zh: 令我印象尤为深刻的一点是：孩子们在学习新知识的同时，全都玩得很开心。

sentences.en: SEB: Which is a key aim of any lesson with this age group
sentences.zh: SEB: 这正是面向这个年龄段学生的任何一堂课的关键目标。

sentences.en: And although these kids had no problems with folding the paper, with younger children you could do origami to help practise fine motor skills
sentences.zh: 尽管这些孩子折纸毫无困难，但对于年龄更小的孩子，折纸则可用于练习精细动作技能。

sentences.en: LIA: Absolutely
sentences.zh: LIA: 完全同意。

sentences.en: Shall we talk about the individual children we saw on the video? l wrote all their names down and took some notes
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈视频中出现的各个孩子吧？我把他们的名字都记下来了，还做了些笔记。

sentences.en: SEB: Yes, I did too
sentences.zh: SEB: 是的，我也这么做了。

sentences.en: LIA: OK, good
sentences.zh: LIA: 好的，很好。

sentences.en: Let's start with Sid
sentences.zh: 我们先从西德（Sid）开始吧。

sentences.en: SEB: He was interesting because before they started doing the origami, he was being quite disruptive
sentences.zh: SEB: 他很有意思，因为在开始折纸之前，他表现得相当捣乱。

sentences.en: LIA: Yes
sentences.zh: LIA: 是的。

sentences.en: He really benefited from having to use his hands - it helped him to settle down and start concentrating
sentences.zh: 他确实从动手操作中获益良多——这帮助他平静下来并开始专注。

sentences.en: SEB: Yes, I noticed that too
sentences.zh: SEB: 是的，我也注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: What about Jack?
sentences.zh: 杰克（Jack）呢？

sentences.en: I noticed he seemed to want to work things out for himself
sentences.zh: 我注意到他似乎更倾向于自己摸索解决问题。

sentences.en: LIA: Mmm
sentences.zh: LIA: 嗯。

sentences.en: You could see him trying out different things rather than asking the teacher for help
sentences.zh: 你能看到他不断尝试不同的方法，而不是向老师求助。

sentences.en: What did you make of Naomi?
sentences.zh: 你对娜奥米（Naomi）有什么看法？

sentences.en: SEB: She seemed to be losing interest at one point but then she decided she wanted her mouse to be the best and that motivated her to try harder
sentences.zh: SEB: 她一度似乎失去了兴趣，但后来她决定要把自己的老鼠折得最棒，这种想法激励她更加努力。

sentences.en: LIA: She didn't seem satisfied with hers in the end, though
sentences.zh: LIA: 不过最后她对自己的作品似乎并不满意。

sentences.en: SEB: No
sentences.zh: SEB: 是的。

sentences.en: LIA: Anya was such a star
sentences.zh: LIA: 安雅（Anya）真是个明星。

sentences.en: She listened so carefully and then produced the perfect bird with very little effort
sentences.zh: 她听得非常认真，随后几乎毫不费力就折出了完美的鸟。

sentences.en: SEB: Mmm - think the teacher could have increased the level of difficulty for her
sentences.zh: SEB: 嗯——我觉得老师本可以为她提高难度。

sentences.en: LIA: Maybe
sentences.zh: LIA: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I think it was the first time Zara had come across origami
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是扎拉（Zara）第一次接触折纸。

sentences.en: SEB: She looked as if she didn't really get what was going on
sentences.zh: SEB: 她看起来好像不太明白正在发生什么。

sentences.en: LIA: She seemed unsure about what she was supposed to do, but in the end hers didn't turn out too badly
sentences.zh: LIA: 她似乎不确定自己该做什么，但最终她的作品结果其实并不差。

sentences.en: SEB: Yeah
sentences.zh: SEB: 是啊。

sentences.en: I'm sure it was a positive learning experience for her
sentences.zh: 我确信这对她来说是一次积极的学习体验。

sentences.en: LIA: Mmm
sentences.zh: LIA: 嗯。

sentences.en: LIA: think one reason why the origami activity worked so well in this class was that the teacher was well prepared
sentences.zh: LIA: 我认为折纸活动在这个班级中效果如此之好的一个原因是老师准备充分。

sentences.en: SEB: Right. it think it would have taken me ages to prepare examples, showing each of the steps involved in making the bird
sentences.zh: SEB: 没错。我觉得要是让我来准备示例，展示制作鸟形的每一步，恐怕得花上我好长时间。

sentences.en: But that was a really good idea
sentences.zh: 但那真是个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: The children could see what they were aiming for and much better for them to be able to hold something, rather than just looking at pictures
sentences.zh: 孩子们能清楚地看到自己最终要完成的目标，而且让他们亲手拿着实物，远比仅仅看图片效果要好得多。

sentences.en: LIA: Mmm - those physical examples supported her verbal explanations really well
sentences.zh: LIA: 嗯——这些实物范例很好地支撑了她的口头讲解。

sentences.en: SEB: It's strange that origami isn't used more widely
sentences.zh: SEB: 折纸没有被更广泛地使用，这真有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: LIA: Well, teachers may just feel it's not that appealing to children who are used to doing everything on computers, especially boys
sentences.zh: LIA: 嗯，老师们可能只是觉得，对于习惯于一切都在电脑上操作的孩子们（尤其是男孩）来说，折纸并不那么有吸引力。

sentences.en: Even if they're aware of the benefits
sentences.zh: 即使他们已经意识到折纸的好处。

sentences.en: SEB: Oh, I don't know
sentences.zh: SEB: 哦，这个我不太清楚。

sentences.en: It's no different to any other craft activity
sentences.zh: 它与其他手工活动并没有什么不同。

sentences.en: I bet it's because so
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌，原因就在于……

sentences.en: many teachers are clumsy like me
sentences.zh: 许多老师像我一样手笨。

sentences.en: LIA: That's true - too much effort required if you're not good with your hands
sentences.zh: LIA: 的确如此——如果你动手能力不强，就需要付出太多努力。

sentences.en: SEB: Well, anyway, I think we should try it out in our maths teaching practice with
sentences.zh: SEB: 好吧，不管怎样，我认为我们应在三年级的数学教学实践中尝试一下折纸。

sentences.en: Year 3. can see using origami is a really engaging way of reinforcing children's knowledge of geometric shapes, like they were doing in the video, but I think it would also work really well for presenting fractions, which is coming up soon
sentences.zh: 我能看出，折纸是一种非常吸引人的方法，可用来巩固孩子们对几何图形（如视频中所展示的）的认知；但我认为，它也同样非常适合用于讲授分数概念，而这一内容很快就要讲到了。

sentences.en: LIA: Good idea - that's something most of the kids in that class might struggle with
sentences.zh: LIA: 好主意——这正是那个班大多数孩子可能会感到困难的内容。

sentences.en: Origami would also be good practice for using symmetry - but I think they did that last term
sentences.zh: 折纸也有助于练习对称性——不过我想他们上学期已经学过这部分了。

sentences.en: SEB: OK - well let's try and get some ideas together and plan the lesson next week
sentences.zh: SEB: 好的——那我们下周一起集思广益，规划这堂课吧。

sentences.en: TUTOR: OK, if you could all stop
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，请大家停下来。
